accessibility.description: Beholder adds keyboard navigation and speech for the story, exploration, menus, character sheets, inventory, trading, and turn-based combat through NVDA or JAWS, with Windows SAPI as a fallback. The mod documents support for the Windows Steam version; compatibility with other store builds is unconfirmed. It is in beta: the core gameplay has been tested, but a full campaign has not been completed and some interfaces have only been lightly tested. Known issues include reports of problems casting spells outside combat and missing or overlapping announcements.
